battute.testo: This week I shipped the morning receipt in Myynd. When I open the app, one card says what got done overnight: replies drafted, files saved, things set aside. Nothing else on the screen.

Two days before that, notes sync went out to the beta testers. My notes and my mail now live in the same brain, so the drafts know what I wrote down yesterday. That is the part that makes it feel like me, not like a tool.
The next milestone is simple and a bit scary: the first founder who pays for it. Not a waitlist, not a demo. One person who would be annoyed if it stopped working tomorrow morning.
